title: Кібератака групи UAC-0098 на державні органи України із застосуванням фреймворку Metasploit (CERT-UA#4560)

entities.name: UAC-0098
entities.gloss: A threat actor group tracked by CERT-UA associated with cyberattacks and cybercrime operations.

entities.name: TrickBot
entities.gloss: A prominent cybercrime group known for developing and operating malware of the same name.

entities.name: Meterpreter
entities.gloss: An advanced payload and post-exploitation tool that provides interactive command and control access.

entities.gloss: A malicious ISO disk image file distributed as an email attachment in a phishing campaign.

entities.name: a.docx
entities.gloss: A lure Microsoft Word document opened to distract the victim during malware execution.

entities.gloss: A malicious Windows shortcut file used to trigger a PowerShell script execution chain.

entities.gloss: A PowerShell script designed to execute a decoy document and a malicious payload executable.

entities.name: loader.exe
